markdown-text-editor.min.js is the browser build (dist/markdown-text-editor.min.js) of the npm package
markdown-text-editor 1.9.5, https://github.com/nezanuha/markdown-text-editor, without its source map comment.
To update it: npm pack markdown-text-editor@<version>, copy dist/markdown-text-editor.min.js here and remove the
last line (//# sourceMappingURL=...).

The bundle includes:
- marked 18.x (MIT License), https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.x (Apache License 2.0 or Mozilla Public License 2.0), https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- styles generated with Tailwind CSS 4.x (MIT License), https://tailwindcss.com
